about: The emulator legs .github/workflows/devices.yml runs; .github/tools/device-run.sh runs one by hand.
tier: core runs on the public repo's pull requests, wide adds the weekly legs, release adds the rest. Each tier includes the ones before it.
profile is an avdmanager device id (avdmanager list device -c, command-line tools 23.0).
api, target and arch make the system image: system-images;android-<api>;<target>;<arch>.
hardware overrides the AVD's config.ini after it's made (the handhelds have no stock profile).
disk is the AVD's data partition (disk.dataPartition.size), 4096M unless a leg sets it. Unset, the emulator wanted 12288 MB free on the runner to make it and quit.
postures (foldables): folded, half-open, unfolded, each changed with the app open.
variants: font-<scale>, display-largest, dark, rtl-<language>, landscape, portrait, gamepad, dpad, tv-launcher.
After each posture, and each variant but the input ones (gamepad, dpad, tv-launcher), device-test.sh reruns variant_tests and the smoke tests.
monkey: that many random events with a fixed seed at the end (device-test.sh --monkey; Android 11 or later, where it turns the network off).
Postures and variants change system settings, so device-run.sh only runs them on emulators, and puts each setting back.

legs.name: Small phone, Android 15
legs.why: 360 dp wide, the narrow case (close to a Galaxy Z Fold cover screen's width); biggest text and display size

legs.name: Galaxy Z Fold shape, Android 16
legs.why: 337 dp cover screen and 674x841 dp inner screen; folds, half-opens and unfolds with the app open; Android 16 ignores orientation locks on large screens

legs.name: Tablet, Android 15
legs.why: RedMagic Astra class tablet (1280x800 dp); portrait, Hebrew text and dark mode

legs.name: 1080p handheld, Android 13
legs.why: Retroid Pocket 5 / AYN Odin 2 class: 6 in 1920x1080 landscape panel (768x432 dp), controller first

legs.name: Phone, Android 6
legs.why: close to minSdk 21: newer-API calls (like PcView's Html.fromHtml) and the first runtime-permission release

legs.name: Small phone, Android 5.0
legs.why: minSdk 21, the oldest Android the README promises

legs.name: Large phone, Android 16
legs.why: big modern phone (448x997 dp); Android 14+ non-linear text scaling up to 200%

legs.name: Pixel Fold shape, Android 15
legs.why: 411 dp cover screen and a wide 841x701 dp inner screen

legs.name: 4.7 in handheld, Android 11
legs.why: Retroid Pocket 4 Pro class 1334x750 panel: only 375 dp tall in landscape

legs.name: Android TV 11
legs.why: NVIDIA Shield class TV box: leanback launcher entry, D-pad only (the manifest declares leanback and a TV banner)

legs.name: 7 in tablet, Android 10
legs.why: 960x600 dp tablet; Android 10 is the first with a system dark theme

legs.name: Lean test image, Android 11
legs.why: no browser, no keyboard app and no System UI: help links and text fields must not crash without them

legs.name: Phone, newest Android
legs.why: the platform the app compiles against (compileSdk 37), before targetSdk moves

legs.name: 16 KB pages, Android 16
legs.why: 16 KB memory pages (newer devices): the native libraries must still load

legs.name: arm64 libraries via translation (experimental)
legs.why: installs the app as arm64-v8a so the arm64-only PyroWave and adrenotools libraries load through the image's ARM translation
